component.name: Snipshot
component.summary: Snip part of your screen and mark it up

description.p: Snipshot is a snipping tool for Linux, modeled on the Windows Snipping Tool. Snip a rectangle, a window, a freeform shape or the whole screen, then mark it up and copy or save it.

ul.li: Rectangle, window, freeform and full-screen snips, with an optional delay
Pen, highlighter, shapes (rectangle, oval, line, arrow) and text
Eraser, crop, undo and redo, zoom
Copies to the clipboard and saves to your Pictures folder automatically

description.p: The window stays out of your snips on Wayland, the editor opens at full size, the snip overlay isn't squashed across several monitors, the toolbars fit narrow windows, and errors show in the editor. New .rpm package for Fedora.
Download and install updates from inside the app.
Larger text and controls, and a Light, Dark or System theme setting.
